_note: Investigation design v0.2. kind "essential" = the four clues (E1–E4) that converge on Frequency Tower; kind "theory" = notes the player can pin but that lead nowhere on their own. Entries marked draft wait on the story team.

missing_report.title: Missing user report
missing_report.description: Official report: Skye is missing. Time missing: “a long time” (according to the agents).
missing_report.source: Arrivals entry papers · filed by Frequen City Police

e1_pickup.title: Bar pickup confirmation
e1_pickup.description: A pickup slip stuck to Skye’s fridge: one order of food and snacks from the bar, marked “ready for pickup today”.
e1_pickup.points: The slip names The Bar. It records an order, but there’s no signature for collection.
e1_pickup.strengthen: On its own, the slip shows an order was placed. It doesn’t show who collected it.

e2_transfer.title: Last activity log
e2_transfer.description: The activity log on Leevee’s desk: Skye requested the latest song renders be transferred to “Frequency Tower”. Status: delivered. Her earlier transfers in the log all went to Voidworks.
e2_transfer.points: Skye asked for the latest renders to go to Frequency Tower. Her earlier requests went to Voidworks.
e2_transfer.strengthen: The log shows where the music went and who asked. It doesn’t show what happened after it arrived.

e3_sighting.title: Bartender's sighting
e3_sighting.description: The bartender handed Skye her food and watched her head toward Frequency Tower, snacks in one arm. Later, Leevee came in asking where she went.
e3_sighting.points: She left The Bar carrying her order, heading toward Frequency Tower.
e3_sighting.strengthen: The bartender saw which way she went. It doesn’t show where she ended up.

e4_access.title: Tower access records
e4_access.description: A rooftop entry was logged outside normal hours. The maintenance slip notes that the roof door code follows the tower’s original dedication year.
e4_access.points: Someone used the rooftop entrance outside normal hours. The log doesn’t name them.
e4_access.strengthen: The log shows someone went up to the roof. It doesn’t show who.

police_activity.title: Last known activity report
police_activity.description: The department’s version of events: “She was online. Then she wasn’t.” Signed by four officers, none of whom checked.

apt_spill.title: Red residue on the counter
apt_spill.description: A red smear by the sink. Leevee wiped most of it before I got a look. Blood? Sauce? In this city it could be either, and it could be art.

slos_theories.title: Agent theories
slos_theories.description: The agents’ working theories, each proposed with total confidence: (1) she gave herself one of her own Great Generals orders and went elsewhere; (2) a standing order from the Realm finally fired; (3) a private video went public and she’s hiding from fame; (4) the government; (5) one of her MEGA-BYTES hatched; (6) the city model in the garage swallowed her.

vw_rival.title: Rival publisher theory
vw_rival.description: The Voidworks developer is sure a rival publisher poached Skye. Evidence offered: “vibes”, and a competitor’s logo he finds suspicious.

sg_tokyo.title: Tokyo Fashion Week theory
sg_tokyo.description: The boutique clerk thinks Skye flew to Tokyo Fashion Week without telling anyone. The clerk would have.

bar_patron.title: A regular's account
bar_patron.description: A regular swears Skye left in a black van, or a red one, or got carried off by a very large bird. Unreliable, but very committed.

roof_stain.title: Red stain
roof_stain.description: A red smear on the deck. It smells suspiciously like ketchup.

roof_shirt.title: Discarded shirt
roof_shirt.description: A shirt on a lounge cushion, folded at the hem. Someone got warm up here.

roof_knife.title: Knife
roof_knife.description: A knife with crumbs on the blade. The kind the bar hands out with the food.

roof_food.title: Food packaging
roof_food.description: Takeaway boxes and burst ketchup packets from the bar. Somebody had a picnic up here.
